Name: Ace's and Lumisteria's Hairstyles Bundle
Author: xChesirex
Description:
A mod bundle featuring Ace's and Lumisteria's hairstyles, allowing the player to add them in without the use of Get Glam or using vanilla replacers. All it requires is Content Patcher to work! They'll be found on the character creation menu ( Or in the Wiard's shrine ) after the vanilla hairstyles. 

It works in multiplayer! Just make sure both the farmhands and the host has it, otherwise the other party without it will be seeing some bald heads running around. I'm unsure if it works in mobile, as I don't use mobile and have no way of testing it. 

This mod couldn't be done without Malic creating the base for it! 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8821]Non Replacing Hair Resource

[/url]And of course, all credits goes to Ace and Lumisteria for their hairstyle sprites!
